rooms.name: Now Entering The Midlands
rooms.desc:
Well, welcome to Scythe's second creation and hopefully not
my last.  This area is based on a trilogy of fantasy books I am reading
called the Sword of Truth Trilogy by Terry Goodkind.  I admit that it
is not entirely my creation, but it will make a very interesting area.
This will be one of the biggest areas on the mud, and it consists of 
about 5 separate parts.  There are mobs ranging from all levels as
well as equipment ranging from all levels.  There are a couple of
REALLY good pieces of equipment in here that should be worth the trouble
of getting them.  If you have any questions or comments, good or bad, 
just post them and I will respond.

rooms.name: In The Hartland Forest
rooms.desc:
You are now standing in a forest with a very thick canopy.  You
can hardly see where you entered the forest from due to the fact that
the canopy blocks out all light from overhead.  The trees around you 
look to be very old.  Exits lie in all directions.

rooms.name: A Path Through The Hartland
rooms.desc:
You continue on the path, noticing the size of the trees all
around you.  You feel dwarfed next to these creations of nature.  Their
sheer size and age amazes you.  You notice a hole in the ground off to
your right.  The paths continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: A Worn Path In The Forest
rooms.desc:
The path continues yet deeper into the forest, you are starting
to wonder if you would be able to find your way out of here if you go
much deeper.  You have noticed that there are many creatures that are
scurrying about, none that are threatening though.  The path turns so 
that it heads south or west.

rooms.name: Deeper In The Forest
rooms.desc:
You are going deeper and deeper into the forest.  You begin to
get a faint feeling of magic in the air.  You can feel a powerful source
of magic is nearby, you just hope that whatever it is, it is friendly.
The path leads north, east or south.

rooms.name: Entrance To An Old Cabin
rooms.desc:
You stand before an old cabin.  From the looks of it this cabin
has been here for a hundred years.  There is a porch and on the porch 
you see a rocking chair that looks in perfect condition.  There are two
windows to the cabin, but they are so dirty that you can't see into the 
interior of the cabin.  The cabin lies to the north and a path leads off 
to the east.

rooms.name: Further In The Hartland Forest
rooms.desc:
You can tell that the forest is growing more dense with every
step you take.  It looks as though soon you will not be able to continue
walking through the forest.  A path leads to the east and a similar
path heads off in a westernly direction.

rooms.name: The Hartland Forest
rooms.desc:
You notice that the trees in this particular area are much 
larger than the ones you have previously seen.  You feel like a dwarf
as you continue to walk along this path.  The path leads to the north,
south and the west.

rooms.name: End Of The Path
rooms.desc:
You seem to have come to the abrupt end of the path as the path
has been completely swallowed up by nature. The only way out is back to 
the south.

rooms.name: An Abrupt End To The Path
rooms.desc:
The path here seems to have disappeared.  Try as you might, you 
cannot seem to find the path.  Your only exit is back to the north.

rooms.name: Zedd's Log Cabin
rooms.desc:
You are now in the old cabin.  You notice a sign on the wall
which indicates that this is the humble abode of Zeddicus Zu'l Zorander,
a wizard of the First Order.  You notice a large table, some shelves
with many books and suck on them.  There is a fire going in the hearth
and a pot of stew cooking on it.  You wonder where this wizard was and
if he would mind if you took some of his food.

rooms.name: The Edge Of The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You now stand at the edge of the pass which goes through the
boundary.  You aren't sure why, but you feel the presence of spirits 
nearby.  The path leads north or south.

rooms.name: In The Forest
rooms.desc:
The forest canopy is not quite as dense here and you find that
you can see much better now.  The wildlife has been friendly enough
in the forest, you hope that it stays that way.  You can follow the
path east or west.

rooms.name: Deeper In The Hartland Forest
rooms.desc:
You have moved deeper into the forest and you find that the
canopy has sealed off the ceiling of the forest again and there is
once again no light coming through.  There are huge, ancient trees
all around.  You wonder at how old they must be.  You can head to
the east or to the south.

rooms.name: A Clearing In The Forest
rooms.desc:
You suddenly emerge from the thickest part of the forest and
you are now standing in a large clearing in the forest.  You notice
a circle of rocks at the center of the clearing indicating that other
people have been here before and camped.  For some strange reason, you 
feel safe and secure in this clearing.  There are entrances back into
the dense forest to the east and the north.

rooms.name: In The Forest
rooms.desc:
You are once again in a dark and dense part of the forest.
It is difficult to see where you are headed.  You hope that you 
don't walk into, BAM!! Too late, you just walked into a tree.  You can
head west or north.

rooms.name: Further In The Hartland
rooms.desc:
You are walking on a path that is rather clear for right now.
Looking ahead of you, you can tell that the forest gets much thicker
and you begin to wonder how long you can follow this path.  You can 
head to the north or the south.

rooms.name: Deeper In The Hartland
rooms.desc:
You are now into the thick of the forest.  The canopy seals out
all light in here.  You notice that the trees are growing larger and 
older as you move deeper.  You can go east, west or north.

rooms.name: The Darkest Part Of The Forest
rooms.desc: It's too dark to see anything at all!

rooms.name: At The Fringe Of The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of the boundary, or more to the point,
the pass that goes through the boundary.  You can see a glowing green 
wall that marks the division of the boundary from the pass.  You can 
continue on to the south and the west.

rooms.name: In The Pass Through The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You are now on the pass that will take you through the boundary.
Here the pass is rather wide so you are not that close to the boundary
yet.  You can see the green wall from here, but it is a distance away.
You can head east or north.

rooms.name: At The Large Boulder
rooms.desc:
You notice that the pass heads uphill here.  There is a large
boulder here that almost blocks the path.  With all of the boulders and
rock formations here in the pass, it is very difficult to see what lies 
ahead.  The pass leads in all directions.

rooms.name: Past The Boulder
rooms.desc:
You are now past the large boulder but you are now much closer
to the boundary.  You don't think you want to hang around here for long.
You can head east or west.

rooms.name: At The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You are now so close you are almost in the boundary.  You can
see many spirits of the people you love and hate calling you to join 
them in there.  You know if you enter you will never come back.  You 
can go to the west or the south.

rooms.name: At The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You are still just along the edge of the boundary.  You hear 
the longing calls of the spirits through the wall and have to give all
your concentration in order to keep from heeding their calls.  You can
continue downhill to the south or head back to the north.

rooms.name: At The Boundary
rooms.desc:
At the green wall to the boundary, you can feel yourself being
drawn in and do not think it would be wise to remain here for long.  
It could be a matter of life and death if you remain.  The pass leads
north and west.

rooms.name: At The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You are moving away from the boundary, but you are still too
close for comfort.  The calls from the spirits are still rather loud
from here and it is still taking you quite a bit of concentration not
to go running to them.  You can continue on to the east and the west.

rooms.name: Crossroads In The Pass
rooms.desc:
You have come to a crossroads in the pass.  You notice that
all the paths look the same and that there are not really any traces
of life here.  Paths lie in all directions.

rooms.name: Entrance To A Cave
rooms.desc:
You stand before a rather large cave.  It does not appear to
have life of any kind, but since you can't see in there, you cannot
tell.  The pass leads north and south, and the cave lies to the east.

rooms.name: The Cave In The Pass
rooms.desc:
The cave is rather large.  You can see a huge pile of skeletons
in the dirt against the wall of the cave.  It doesn't appear that there
is anything in here right now, but obviously something lives here.  You
begin to wonder if it would be wise to wait for them to return.  The 
only exit is to the west.

rooms.name: Another Pass In The Boundary
rooms.desc:
This pass is a bit steeper than the others.  You can feel the
strain on the muscles in your legs as you begin to hike up the pass.
You have a constant feeling of uneasiness in this place.  The pass
leads east and north.

rooms.name: The Top Of The Rise
rooms.desc:
After hiking up the slope you appear to have reached the top,
only to find yourself closer to the boundary.  You can once again hear
the beckoning of the spirits.  You can go back down the slope to the
south or continue on the pass to the west.

rooms.name: Next To The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You are now standing directly next to the boundary.  You are 
so close to it that you can feel the magic and the death emanating
from it.  The pass continues to the south or to the east.

rooms.name: Next To The Boundary
rooms.desc:
Still walking right next to the boundary, you continue on a 
path sloping downward.  The eerie green color is really starting to
annoy you along with the voices of the spirits.  You feel you might
go insane if you stay here to much longer.  You can continue on to
the south or head back up the slope to the north.

rooms.name: The Bottom Of The Slope
rooms.desc:
You are now at the bottom of the slope, and a little farther
away from the actual boundary, but you can still hear the spirits
calling to you.  The pass heads north up the slope or to the east.

rooms.name: Away From The Boundary
rooms.desc:
Now that you are a little farther away from the boundary, the
call of the spirits is not as loud and you feel you might actually
remain sane a while longer.  The pass continues east or heads back west.

rooms.name: Entrance To A Cavern
rooms.desc:
You stand before a narrow but long cavern.  It is the narrowest
part of the pass, and it is where the sides of the boundary almost meet.
You can see a faint light on the other side of the cavern.  You can go in 
all directions.

rooms.name: The Edge Of The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You notice that the path has leveled off here and that the 
boulders do not block your view here.  You can follow the path east
or west.

rooms.name: Death At The Hands Of The Keeper
rooms.desc:
You know as soon as you walk in here that all is lost.  The 
Keeper smiles down at you wickedly.  Using his Subtractive magic, he 
slices open your abdomen to read your entrails.  You try to scream but
no sound escapes as he has ripped your vocal cords out.  He then begins
to tear your limbs off one at a time, as if he were picking an insect
apart.  You never thought you would ever wish for death.

rooms.name: In Between The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You have entered the cavern's passage and you realize that
the walls of the boundary are on both sides of you.  In fact, they
are so close together at this point that you have to keep your arms
in close to your body to keep from touching the boundary on either
side.  You may continue on through the passage south or head back 
north.

rooms.name: Lost In The Cavern
rooms.desc:
Looking back, you can no longer see the light from outside the
cavern to the north or the south.  You realize that you really don't 
know which way you are headed.

rooms.name: Almost Through The Cavern
rooms.desc:
You can now see light up ahead and it looks to be the way out
of here.  Looking back all you see is blackness and the greenish color
of the boundary walls.  You can exit the cavern to the south or head 
back into it to the north.

rooms.name: Through The Boundary
rooms.desc:
You are finally out of the boundary.  You have decided that
you will be happy if you never have to go back there again in your
entire life.  As you look around, you realize how much smaller the 
trees are in this forest compared to the trees in the Hartland forest.
Something about this forest warns you of great danger.  Paths lead off
in all directions.

rooms.name: In The Midlands Forest
rooms.desc:
Standing in the forest, you almost feel at home again now that
you are out of the pass in the boundary.  There is a tree that stands
out to your right, it has many things carved into the bark.  You have 
noticed that there really are not any of the smaller, harmless creatures
such as the ones in the Hartlands Forest.  The path heads out of the
forest to the west or continues deeper to the east.

rooms.name: A Crossroads In The Midlands
rooms.desc:
You are now standing in a crossroads of some sort with the path
splitting off in many directions.  There is another tree with something
cut into the bark in front of you.  As you look up a large branch falls
off of one of the trees to crash right next to you.  Another inch or two
and you would be underneath of it.  The path turns to the north and the
south.  You can also head back to the west.

rooms.name: In The Midlands
rooms.desc:
You are heading deeper and deeper into the forest.  For some
odd reason you are getting the feeling like you are being watched by
someone or something.  You decide that haste would be in order as you
are sure you don't want to meet up with whatever is out there.

rooms.name: A Turn In The Path
rooms.desc:
The path now turns in the forest.  It heads to the east or back
to the south.

rooms.name: Continuing On The Path
rooms.desc:
Looking around you, you notice that the trees and underbrush 
are more sparse here and the path is a bit more visible.  Even though
the growth here is not as thick, you still feel as though you are being
watched or possibly even hunted.  The path turns to the south or goes
back to the west.

rooms.name: The Edge Of The Midlands Forest
rooms.desc:
The forest has almost completely disappeared here, and so has
the path.  Most likely the path has disappeared because no one ever
travels this way.  Despite that thought, you are still glad to be 
moving away from the forest and that eerie feeling of being watched.
The path looks to continue to the east and to the north.

rooms.name: In The Hills
rooms.desc:
The hills here are much steeper and rockier than the ones that
you traveled through in the pass.  As you look around, you notice no
immediate signs of life in these parts.  This area is actually quite 
steep and appears to lead to a mountain off in the distance.

rooms.name: Climbing The Rocky Terrain
rooms.desc:
You are still heading up and the terrain is much rockier here.
You are beginning to sweat from the work of climbing.  It looks as 
though soon the path will be almost unclimbable, or at least what little
bit of a path you can see.

rooms.name: Up The Slope
rooms.desc:
You continue to head up the slope.  All of a sudden, a boulder
comes rolling down the slope.  You just barely dive out of the way as
it rolls by you down the slope.  Now you wonder if someone pushed that
at you or if it just rolled on it's own.  You can continue climbing to 
the south as the path to the east is completely blocked or you can head
back to the west.

rooms.name: A Sharp Rise In The Path
rooms.desc:
You are now before a sharp rise in the path.  It is some kind
of plateau and it looks climbable from here.  Guess you won't know
until you try.  You can climb the rise or head back down the path.

rooms.name: On The Plateau
rooms.desc:
After finally reaching the top of the plateau, you realize that
you have climbed a good twenty feet or so.  From this height you have a
breathtaking view of the forest and hills below.  Looking around you
you notice a skeleton lying in the dirt.  It looks like he has drawn
something in the dirt.  You can go back down the plateau or you can 
continue to the west.

rooms.name: The Edge Of The Plateau
rooms.desc:
You have reached the far side of the plateau.  Your view of
the forest is obscured by massive boulders.  You can now climb down
this side of the plateau or head back towards the other edge.

rooms.name: The Foot Of The Mountain
rooms.desc:
You finish climbing down from the top of the plateau without
any major injuries.  You are now standing at the base of the mountain
you could see off in the distance earlier.  As you look at the mountain
you realize that the climb to the top is almost straight up.  You can 
head south to the base of the mountain or you can climb back up to the
top of the plateau.

rooms.name: The Base Of The Mountain
rooms.desc:
Standing below the mountain, you conclude that it would be
one hell of a climb to reach the top.  It appears to head almost
straight up right into the clouds.  The view from the top must be
quite breathtaking.  You can climb the mountain or head back down 
to below the plateau.

rooms.name: Climbing The Face Of The Mountain
rooms.desc:
You are now climbing the face of this great mountain.  You 
cannot believe you are even thinking about doing this, much less
actually doing it.  You now know you will always regret doing this.

rooms.name: Climbing The Face Of The Mountain
rooms.desc:
You continue on your climb up the face of this outrageously
high mountain.  You are wondering if you will have the energy to finish
the climb.  You better have!

rooms.name: Climbing The Face Of The Mountain
rooms.desc:
Nearing the end of your endurance, you wonder how much higher
you will have to climb as you have not found a place to rest yet.  It
had better be soon or you will be eternally resting at the base of the
mountain.

rooms.name: The Cave At The Top Of The Mountain
rooms.desc:
You are now inside the cave.  At the back of the cave is a
rather large egg sitting in a very large nest made out of straw.  
Whatever laid that egg, you surely don't want to meet it, especially
if it is a dragon's egg.  Everyone knows how fiercely protective
dragons can be of their young.

rooms.name: Another Crossroads In The Midlands
rooms.desc:
You leave one crossroads and come to another.  The paths here
are a bit worn down indicating that others besides yourself come through
here.  The paths lead off in three directions, east, west and north.

rooms.name: A Small Clearing
rooms.desc:
This clearing in the forest seems odd because all around you
the forest is so dense that you cannot exit the clearing except by
the way you entered it.  For some strange reason you feel safer here
than you have the entire time you have been in this forest.

rooms.name: A Turn In The Forest
rooms.desc:
The path begins to wind a bit at this point.  The path has
been growing a bit narrower as you continue into the forest.  At 
least the forest isn't so dark here that you can't see where you
are going but it is still dense enough that you really can't see
what lies beyond the forest.  The path turns to the south and it leads
back to the east.

rooms.name: A Split In The Narrow Path
rooms.desc:
The path has split off in two directions.  There is a small
clearing in the forest here where the path lies indicating that this
must be a well used path.  You also notice that both the eastern and
western paths are much wider than the ones you have been traveling on
up to this point.  The path splits off, heading east, west or back to 
the north.

rooms.name: Another Turn In The Path
rooms.desc:
The path turns yet again so that it leads off to the south or
you can head back to the west.

rooms.name: The Main Crossroads
rooms.desc:
You are standing in what is obviously a major crossroads as
it is very worn and wide.  There are hoof prints and footprints all 
over and they are relatively fresh.  It would not be advisable to 
wait here long since many people pass through here.  The path goes
off in all directions.

rooms.name: The Main Northern Road
rooms.desc:
This is the major road that heads north through the midlands
forest.  It is rather wide, wide enough to march an army on and it
looks to head directly north for a little ways.  The road continues
on to the north and the south.

rooms.name: A Split In The Western Road
rooms.desc:
The western road splits here, so that it leads north, east or
west.  There are still many tracks in the dirt, whatever came through
here, came through here in quite a hurry.  They appear to have been
running from something.

rooms.name: A Wide Path
rooms.desc:
This path is quite wide, but not to the scale of the western
road.  The trees line the path on both sides with some underbrush 
sprouting up here and there.  This path must be used often, for there
is nothing growing in the path.

rooms.name: The Path Splits Four Ways
rooms.desc:
Here the path splits off in all directions.  Off in the distance
you think you here the sounds of a small village of some sort.  It would
appear from the path to the west that not too many people travel to or
from whatever lies in that direction.

rooms.name: Entering Agaden Reach
rooms.desc:
The forest extends into a valley of some kind that appears to
be rather large.  The forest here is much darker and you feel as though
you are being watched as you walk through this valley.  For some reason
you get a terrible feeling of danger about this place.  The valley 
extends to the north or you can reenter the midlands forest to the south.

rooms.name: In Agaden Reach
rooms.desc:
Walking along the path through the valley, you feel your fear
beginning to rise inside you.  It almost looks like the trees have eyes
but then you realize that that is silly, or is it?  The valley extends
to the north and the south.

rooms.name: The Fountain In The Reach
rooms.desc:
You stand in a large, open area in the shape of a circle.  
There are vines growing on the trees all around this circle.  
The path appears to end here at this circle.  The trees completely 
block out the light from the sun or the moon in this clearing.  Your 
only options are to remain here or head back south.

rooms.name: In The Plains
rooms.desc:
Traveling through on this path through the plains is quite a 
change from the deep, thick forest you have been traveling through.  
This is a rather narrow path through these plains and fields, indicating
that the people who live near here do not use animals or equipment to
do their farming.  The path continues through the fields to the west and
back into the forest to the east.

rooms.name: In The Fields
rooms.desc:
The plains have gradually disappeared and now there are only
cultivated fields around you.  These fields are well taken care of but
strangely enough you haven't seen anyone guarding them yet.  The path
continues to the west and the east.

rooms.name: Entrance To The Village
rooms.desc:
You are on a muddy path that leads to a small village.  There
are huts all around you.  Except for a few things you see here and 
there, everything looks to be covered in mud, including the inhabitants.
To the west you enter the village and to the east you enter the fields.

rooms.name: In The Village
rooms.desc:
Looking around you, you notice many small huts with smoke coming
out of an opening in the top of the huts.  Walking through this small
village you see many people, all covered in mud.  They are giving you
strange looks as if to say, "What are you doing here?"

rooms.name: Turn In The Village
rooms.desc:
The huts are becoming fewer in number as you continue further
into the village.  You can see a slightly larger hut off to the east.
The path continues into the village to the south and the west.

rooms.name: Within A Large Hut
rooms.desc:
You now stand inside of one of the larger huts.  There are many
items strewn about and a few beds arranged around the fire at the center
of the hut.  This is obviously the hut of an important person, probably
an elder of the village.  From the looks of the smaller clothes and the
few "toys" in the hut, he is a family man as well.

rooms.name: A Crossroads In The Village
rooms.desc:
From the looks of the people in this village, you are beginning
to understand why they are called the Mud People.  Every inhabitant of
this village is covered in mud from head to toe, including their hair.
The path through the village splits off in all directions, with huts
on all sides of you.

rooms.name: The Spirit Hut
rooms.desc:
You now stand within a very large hut that appears to be some
kind of gathering place for the elders.  There is a bowl full of some
weird looking frogs and another bowl with a strange type of paint in
it.  This appears to be some sort of spirit gathering place.  Your
only exit is to the south.

rooms.name: A Small Hut In The Village
rooms.desc:
This is a much smaller hut with many weapons lying about as well
as many tools.  There is a bed in the corner and a small campfire in the
center, beyond that there is nothing else in this hut.  It is very
spartanesque.  This is probably the hut of a hunter or a warrior.

rooms.name: In The Village
rooms.desc:
The village continues along this road.  The huts are spaced
apart in increments of about ten to twenty feet.  The people are
walking about, minding their business, almost as if they don't even
notice you at all.

rooms.name: A Turn In The Village
rooms.desc:
The path turns here so it is now heading east and north.  The
amount of mud in this village is quite amazing, considering that people
actually live here.  It's no wonder they came to be known as the mud
people.

rooms.name: A Split In The Path
rooms.desc:
The path now splits off in three directions, north, south and
west.

rooms.name: The Busy Center
rooms.desc:
You are standing in what looks to be a main center of the village
with many huts around it and a large open area at the center of these
huts.  There are huts of all types in all directions.

rooms.name: The Village Store
rooms.desc:
You are standing within a shop that appears to carry just about
everything possible.  You see weapons all around you, as well as armor
and magical items of all sorts.  The only exit is to the north.

rooms.name: A Small Hut
rooms.desc:
This hut is really plain.  There are a couple of furs and some
spears around the hut, other than that there isn't much in here.  Your
exit is to the west.

rooms.name: Another Hut
rooms.desc:
There is a small fire burning at the center of the hut with
the smoke coming out of the top of the hut.  There is a bow lying in
the corner and a quiver with many arrows in it.  The exit is to the
east.

rooms.name: A Turn In The Midlands Path
rooms.desc:
The path through the forest turns here.  You are no longer
on a main road, but on a much smaller path that splits off of the
road.  The exits lie to the north and the west.

rooms.name: Deeper In The Midlands
rooms.desc:
The forest is growing much more dense as you continue along
this path.  The trees obscure the light a bit more this deep in the
forest and the path is a bit narrower.  You can follow the path to
the east or the west.

rooms.name: Another Split In The Path
rooms.desc:
The path splits here so that it heads north and south.  You
notice that there are many footprints here as though someone had a
struggle here.  You hope that a similar fate does not befall you.

rooms.name: A Turn In The Midlands
rooms.desc:
The forest is not quite as dense here.  The path has widened a
bit and the trees do not appear to be as large as they are in other parts
of the forest.  The path turns here so that it now leads east or south.

rooms.name: The Edge Of The Midlands
rooms.desc:
Amazingly, you continue on the path and just when the path looks
to be at it's end, you are at the edge of the forest.  The trees have
almost completely disappeared here.  You can see the faint marks where
someone was dragged down this path.  The path now leads east and north.

rooms.name: In The Deep Midlands
rooms.desc:
The forest is much deeper here.  It almost seems as if the forest
has swallowed up all light from the "outside" world.  You can barely see
the hint of a path.  You are getting the idea that no one travels this
way much anymore.  You can go north or south.

rooms.name: Deep In The Midlands
rooms.desc:
You have now lost all signs of a path and you are not even sure
which way would lead you back out of here.  The forest to the south and
east is so thick that you cannot even think of going in that direction.
Your only options are to go east or north.

rooms.name: Lost In The Midlands Forest
rooms.desc:
You are beginning to get dizzy after walking through this forest
because you are lost.  You can't see much and you hurt your nose when you
walked into a tree.  There is a faint light to the south.

rooms.name: Out of The Midlands
rooms.desc:
You are finally out of that forest and can get some feeling of
where you are going now.  You are relieved to finally be out of that
forest and back in the light again.
